Node_n01. We need to decide relevance. The study measures glycated albumin (GA) in gingival crevicular fluid (GCF) in patients with periodontitis and type 2 diabetes. They claim GA in GCF is higher in DM and DM-P groups, correlated with blood HbA1c, and ROC analysis shows cutoff to predict DM. So glycan biomarker: glycated albumin is a glycation product (non-enzymatic glycosylation). It's a glycan-related feature. They link it to disease: diabetes and periodontitis. So relevant. Need full text? Abstract gives clear glycan feature (GA), disease (DM, periodontitis), specimen (GCF), direction (higher in DM), and ROC analysis. But does it give quantitative cue? It says ROC analysis shows optimal cutoff value to predict DM, but no AUC or sensitivity/specificity. It says "high level" but no numbers. So abstract does not provide quantitative metrics. So we need full text to get details. So needs_fulltext = true.

Study type: case-control? They have groups: H, DM, CP, DM-P. They compare levels among groups. That's case-control (case groups vs controls). So study_type = "case-control".
